collections.title: Set Theory and Model Theory: A Connected Foundations Course
assumed_background: Elementary mathematics and comfort reading short proofs; first-order logic and set-theoretic axioms are developed within the course.

collections.title: Constructing Sets, Comparing Infinities, and Choosing Maximal Objects
assumed_background: Sets, functions, countability basics, and induction.

collections.title: What a First-Order Theory Can Say and Force
assumed_background: Quantifiers, basic sets, and finite formal arguments.

collections.title: Completeness, Nonstandard Models, and Incompleteness
assumed_background: First-order syntax, elementary number theory, and computability at an intuitive level.
